entities.name: CD1d-HER2 vaccine enhancement
observations: In established HER2/OVA-expressing B16 melanoma, α-galactosylceramide-loaded CD1d–anti-HER2 fusion protein combined with OVA peptide/CpG vaccination produced greater tumor inhibition than either component alone.

The combination optimized NK and OVA-specific CD8 responses, increased inflammatory dendritic-cell and serum IL-12 responses, and enhanced tumor control depended mainly on CTLs in depletion experiments.

entities.name: αGC CpG melanoma vaccine
observations: In murine B16F10 melanoma, multicomponent nanoparticles containing α-galactosylceramide, CpG, Melan-A:26, and gp100:44 restrained tumor growth, with tumor volume approximately fivefold lower than otherwise similar nanoparticles lacking α-galactosylceramide.
α-galactosylceramide increased intratumoral NKT/NK infiltration and cytokine responses; no survival endpoint or exact p-value was available in the retrieved evidence.

entities.name: Dual-adjuvant HPV vaccine
observations: In mice with established HPV TC-1 tumors, intranasal HPV E6/E7 peptide vaccine containing α-galactosylceramide and CpG-ODN required both adjuvants for strong efficacy.

The dual-adjuvant vaccine significantly expanded antigen-specific CD8 cells and produced sustained tumor elimination in more than 85% of mice; exact p-values and formal survival estimates were not available in the retrieved evidence.

entities.name: Therapeutic cancer vaccination
observations: Preclinical question concerns whether iNKT/CD1d-directed immunotherapy enhances therapeutic CpG plus tumor-peptide vaccination.
